compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Implement check-dd-lexicon.sh with precision vocabulary list
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-dd-lexicon.sh that detects compound requirements and vague vocabulary in done definition strings.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-dd-lexicon.sh

## Precision Vocabulary Rules
Compound detection: presence of ' AND ' or ' and ' as a structural conjunction (not part of a proper noun) → exits 1
Vague vocabulary list: properly, correctly, appropriately, well, good, better, clean, adequate, reasonable, appropriate, suitable, handles, manages (without specific behavior)
Output on failure: JSON {type: 'compound|vague', matched_text: '...', dd: '...'}

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/check-dd-lexicon.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-dd-lexicon.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)
- Script reads DD text from stdin or --dd argument

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S8/T1)
